title: Sugar Magnolia Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Come discover the natural wonders of Sugar Magnolia. Nestled among magnolias, live oaks, and bay trees, Sugar Magnolia is a fabulous house with guest cottage (Sugaree) also available
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Private pool with optional heating - 2 adult sized beach cruiser bikes - All bedrooms have Cable TV access - Golf cart rental friendly community - Private driveway - STEPS to the beach access - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS -Pool heat- The pool can be heated for $50/day in the off-season -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 8) Main Floor: Bedroom 1: Dual bunk beds (sleeps 4), Flat screen TV Bedroom 2: Queen bed, flat screen TV and a sliding glass door that will take you out to the pool deck Shared full bathroom with soaking bath/shower combo, with a dual sink vanity and a separate makeup vanity Second Floor: Bedroom 3: Master suite- King bed, flat screen TV, private desk, ensuite bathroom which features a designer shower and dual sink vanity, Great room, kitchen, dining area and outdoor balcony Come discover the wonders of nature at Sugar Magnolia! Nestled among a canopy of salt spayed live oaks, and magnolias, Sugar Magnolia is a gem of a house which sits within a 1-minute walk to the beach. Enjoy this colorful property, in a small neighborhood next to Grove by the Sea, on Scenic 30-A, in the coastal community of Seagrove Beach. Providing plenty of room for 8 guests, this updated 3 Bedroom / 2 Bath home has 3 decks and a private pool. Like many beach villas along the panhandle, this beach home enjoys a reversed layout with 2 bedrooms downstairs and the main living space, kitchen and master suite upstairs. Awaken to a courtyard garden and open the doors to enjoy your morning coffee on your private deck. The gourmet custom stainless-steel kitchen wraps around an oversized island that provides seating for 4. The open family room with a dining space that seats 6, also features dual sofas, flat screen TV, soundbar and extra seating on the perimeter of the room which allows the whole family to enjoy this beach home the way it was meant to be enjoyed…together. French doors take you out to the porch, which is surrounded by property’s live oaks, providing for outdoor seating and dining in treehouse like setting as you enjoy the coastal breeze. A large pool deck offers plenty of space for lounging poolside and an additional dining table and grill makes this a perfect place to chill and relax outside. The pool can be heated for an extra $250 charge in the colder months. Walk or bike to nearby shops and dining in Seagrove, Seaside and Watercolor. Enjoy fishing, paddle boarding, canoeing, and kayaking, or just kick back and drink in the sunset as you bury your toes in the sand. Beach access is directly across the street, and about a 1-minute walk. IMPORTANT DETAILS: ** Sugaree, the guest cottage for Sugar Magnolia. It's also for rent and can be rented together, or separately. The pool is ONLY available to those renting the larger home. ** The pool can be heated for an extra $50/day charge in the colder months; During the months of October - May. (Pool temperature must be lower than 80 degrees to heat.) FREE WiFi Must be 25 to rent Sorry, no pets!

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
